chapter.verse: “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Pasian Gam in vangliatna tawh hong tung, hih santakah a ding mi kimkhat in a muh matengin a si kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ni guk khit ciangin Zeisu in Piter, Jakob leh Johan-te samin mual sang tungah, gam daihna munah paipih a, amaute mai-ah a meel kilamdang a,
a puan zong leng a, hih leitungah puansawp mi kuamah in a paaksak zawh loh ding zah dongin a paak mahmah hi.
Amaute kiangah Moses leh Elijah kilang a, Zeisu tawh a kiho uh hi.
Tua lai takin Piter in, “Topa aw, hih lai takah kote kong om uh a hoih hi. Nang ading buk khat, Moses ading buk khat, Elijah ading buk khat, buk thum kote hong lamsak in,” a ci hi.
Bang hangin hih bangin a gen hiam i cih leh, amaute lau mahmah uh ahih ciangin, Piter in a gen ding dang a thei kei hi.
Tua lai takin meeingo khat in amaute tuam a, “Hih pa in ka it ka Tapa ahi hi. Ama thu na ngai ta un,” ci-in meii lakah aw khat a ging hi.
Amaute in thakhatin a kim a pam en uh a, amaute tawh Zeisu bek omkhawm longal kuamah dang a mu kei uh hi.
Amaute mualtung pan a kumsuk lai takun Zeisu in, “Mihing Tapa in sihna pan a thawhkik matengin na muhte uh kuamah kiangah gen kei un,” ci-in a nungzuite a kham hi.
Amaute in a lungsim sung uh ah hih thu a khol uh a, sihna pan a thawhkik nading thu in bang cihnopna ahi hiam ci-in khat leh khat a kidong uh hi.
Tua lai takin amaute in, “Elijah hong pai masa ding hi,” ci-in laitheite in bang hangin a gen uh hiam?” ci-in a dot uh leh,
Zeisu in, “Elijah hong pai masa takpi ding a, na khempeuh a bawl kik ding hi. Mihing Tapa in zong gimna tampi leh nialna a thuak ding ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh zo hilo ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin, ke’n kong cih-inah Elijah hong tung zo hi. Amaute in Lai Siangtho sungah ama thu a kigelh khol mah bangin, ama tungah ahih nop bangun ahih zo uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
A nungzuite omna-ah a tun’ uh ciangin, mi tampite in amaute uum uh a, laitheite in amaute tawh thu kikum kidongin a om uh a mu hi.
Thakhatin mihonpite khempeuh in Zeisu a muh uh ciangin lamdang a sa uh a, a kiangah tai-in amah a hopih uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in amaute tawh bang thu kidong na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Mihonpite lakah mi khat in, “Topa aw, a pau thei lo dawi lut ka tapa na kiangah kong paipih hi.

Tua dawi in a matna peuhpeuh ah lei tungah puksak a, a kam sung pan cilphuan bua a, a ha gawi a, a kongkaw gawp thei hi. Dawi a hawlkhiat nadingun na nungzuite kiangah ka nget hangin ahih thei kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Upna nei lo pawlte aw, kei in no tawh bang tanvei omkhawm ding ka hi hiam? Tua naupang ka kiangah hong paipih un,” a ci hi.
Amaute in a hong paipih uh leh, Zeisu a muh ciangin dawi in naupang thakhatin kongkawsak a, lei tungah puk a, cilphuan bua-in a kipeek sawnsawn hi.
Zeisu in, “Hih natna a kipat zawh bang tanvei pha zo ahi hiam?” ci-in naupang’ pa a dot ciangin a pa in, “A neu lai pek pan akipan hi.
Naupang a kisiat nadingin tamveipi meikhuk sungah, tamveipi tui sungah a puksak hi. Ahih hangin, na khat peuhmah na bawl theih leh, kote hong hehpih in la, hong huh in,” ci-in ngen hi.
Zeisu in, “Na bawl theih leh,’ na ci hiam? A um mi ading ahi thei lo a om kei hi,” a ci hi.
Naupang’ pa in thakhatin kiko a, “Ke’n ka um hi. Ka up lohna hong huh in,” ci-in a ngen hi.

Tua lai takin mihonpite kikhawm dingin hong tai uh a, Zeisu in a muh ciangin, “Bengngong leh pauthei lo dawi aw, ama sung pan paikhia in. Tu nung ciangin tum kik nawn kei in, thu kong pia hi,” ci-in kihhuai dawi a taai ciangin,
dawi in kiko-in naupang nakpi-in a kongkawsak khit ciangin a paikhia hi. Naupang in misi tawh kibang ahih ciangin mi tampi in, “A si zo hi,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin, Zeisu in naupang’ khut len a, a phottoh ciangin amah a tho hi.
Zeisu inn sungah a lut khit ciangin a nungzuite in, “Kote in bang hangin tua dawi hawlkhia zo lo ka hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot uh leh,
Zeisu in amaute kiangah, “Hih bang dawi namte thungetna leh antan’na longal tawh a paikhia thei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mun panin amaute paikhia uh a, Galile gam paltanin kuamah in a theih ding a ut kei hi.

Bang hang hiam i cih leh, “Mihing Tapa in mite’ khut tungah kipia ding hi. Tua mite in amah a that ding uh a, amah in thahna a thuak zawh ni thum khit ciangin a thokik ding hi,” ci-in nungzuite a hilh hi.
A nungzuite in tua thu a theih loh uh hangin a dong kik ngam kei uh hi.
Kapernaum khua a tung uh a, inn sungah a om lai takun, “Lampi-ah bang thu kikum na hi uh hiam?” ci-in Zeisu in a nungzuite a dot ciangin,
pau loin a om uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, kua lianbel hiam ci-in lampi-ah khat leh khat a kiseel uh hi.
Zeisu tu a, sawm-le-nihte a sap khit ciangin, “Mi khatpeuh in makai pen a suah nop leh, a khak pen hi hen la, mi khempeuh nasem ahi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Naupang khat samin, amau laizangah a koih khit ciangin a angah tawi-in,
“Keima min tawh hih bang naupangno khat a ngai peuhmah in, kei zong hong ngai hi. Kei hong ngai peuhmah in, kei hong sawlpa zong a ngai hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Johan in, “Sia aw, nangma min tawh dawite a hawlkhia mi khat ka mu uh hi. Amah in eite hong zui lo ahih ciangin ka kham uh hi,” ci-in Zeisu kiangah a gen hi.
Zeisu in, “Tua pa na kham kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keima min tawh nalamdang bawlin, a hong kosia pah thei mi khat beek a om kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite lang khatah a pang lote in, eite tawh a kipawl hi.
Khazih’ mi na hih manun ah tui hai khatpeuh hong pia mi in, aman takpi kong cih-inah, noptuamna ngah loin a om kei ding hi.”
“Kei hong um hih naupang khat a puksak mi peuhmah in a ngawngah an-gawina suang lian khat khihin tuipi sungah kikhia leh, ama ading a hoihzaw ding hi.
Na khut in hong puksak leh, na sattan in.
Khut kim nei-in a mit ngeilo mei, hel khua sungah na pai sangin, khutbui khebui-in nuntakna sungah na tum leh, nang ading a hoihzaw ding hi.
Na khe in nang hong puksak leh, na sattan in.
Khe kim nei-in hel khua sungah hong khul sangin, khutbui khebui-in nuntakna sungah na tum leh, nang ading a hoihzaw ding hi.
Na mittang in hong puksak leh, na khelkhia in.
Than a sih lohna, mei a mit ngeilo hel khua sungah mittang kim nei-in hong khul sangin, mittang khat guak tawh Pasian Gam sungah na tum leh, nang ading a hoihzaw hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, mi khempeuh mei tawh cisawh bangin a kisawh ding uh hi.
Ci in a hoih hangin a alna mang leh, bangci a al kik thei ding hiam? Note sungah ci omsak un la, khat leh khat kilemin om un,” ci-in a gen hi.
